# Evidence over assertion

**Claim.** A model is only as credible as its least-checked number. Every figure should be generated by code and asserted by a test, never typed.

**Where it shows.** [[Sentinel pricing model]] fails its build if a figure is hand-typed (332 assertions). [[Twin-Engine metrics]] replaced a typed IRR with computed figures, see [[Twin-Engine audit]]. The Strategy Lab tests for look-ahead on every release.
